newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish refinery in $23 mln deal with Dutch firm.
newsitem.headline: Polish refinery in $23 mln deal with Dutch firm.

text.p: The Polish Gdansk Refinery SA signed a $23 million contract with Dutch Kinetics Technology International for the purchase of hydrogen manufacturing and processing technologies, the refinery's spokeswoman said.
She said in a statement that under the deal, signed on Wednesday, the Dutch firm will deliver installations to produce and retrieve hydrogen and benzine from the refinery's gases.
The Gdansk Refinery is running a $425 million technical development programme, which is to increase its output to 4.5 million tonnes in 1999 from the current 2.95 million.
